# nexspence_role (Resource)

A Nexspence role grouping privileges.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nexspence_role" "team_a_dev" {
  name        = "team-a-dev"
  description = "Team A developers"
  privileges  = [nexspence_privilege.team_a_rw.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `privileges` (Set of String) Privilege names attached to this role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
